I’m finishing the implementation boundary now, then I’ll give you one concrete before/after proposal for approval—no edits yet.

The key design choice is now clear: `--head` should read source by the snapshot’s immutable tree ID, not by the moving `HEAD` ref. That keeps snippets, call sites, and symbol bodies aligned with the exact graph snapshot even if the branch moves during a command. I’m checking the regression-test surface before proposing it.

The test boundary is also smaller than the original finding suggested: `search --head` already reads committed content correctly. The remaining functional fixes are `neighbors`, `impact`, and `def`, plus the incorrect `explain --head` provenance label. I won’t broaden this into a search rewrite.

### Finding 2 — High: `--head` mixes source provenance

`neighbors`, `impact`, and text/agent `def` load committed graph data but then read snippets or call sites from the live working tree. `explain --head` also incorrectly labels its results as coming from the working tree. `search --head` is already correct.

Proposed solution:

- Add one snapshot-bound source reader:
  - Default/worktree mode reads from disk.
  - `--head` reads from the exact immutable commit recorded in the snapshot using a single batched Git reader.
- Use it for all source enrichment in `neighbors`, `impact`, and `def`, including ambiguous-match bodies and call-site annotations.
- Leave `search` unchanged, adding only a regression test.
- Make the `explain` provenance header mode-aware.
- Add dirty-worktree tests proving every command shows committed content under `--head` and dirty content by default.

Behavior before:

```text
Committed graph entities and edges
        +
dirty working-tree snippets, guards, bodies, or line numbers
```

Behavior after:

```text
--head     → committed graph + committed source
default    → working-tree graph + working-tree source
```

The only user-facing text change would be in `explain`.

Before, in every mode:

```text
DECLARATIONS THE BUILD ERROR NAMED (from the working tree, so your own edits are included)
```

```text
DECLARATIONS THE BUILD ERROR NAMED (from the working tree, so your own edits are included)
```

After, with `--head`:

```text
DECLARATIONS THE BUILD ERROR NAMED (from committed HEAD, so working-tree edits are excluded)
```

### Finding 3 — High: duplicate Claude instruction loading

The repository currently reproduces it:

- [CLAUDE.md](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/CLAUDE.md:1) imports `AGENTS.md`.
- [AGENTS.md](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-graph/AGENTS.md:206) imports the Entire Graph guide.

Claude’s official documentation recommends importing `AGENTS.md` specifically to share instructions without duplication. [Claude Code memory documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)

Proposed product fix:

- Keep the normal guide pointer in `AGENTS.md`.
- When `init-agents` detects that `CLAUDE.md` directly imports the root `AGENTS.md`, replace its managed direct pointer with a marker-only inheritance notice.
- Otherwise retain the current direct guide pointer in `CLAUDE.md`.
- On later runs, restore the direct pointer if the user removes the `AGENTS.md` import.
- Preserve all unmanaged content and test legacy migration plus byte-for-byte idempotence.

```md
<!-- entire-graph:begin -->
This repo has the entire-graph code graph installed. Before exploring code with
grep/find/whole-file reads, read .entire/graph-agent.md — resolution-first guidance
for using graph retrieval, focused source inspection, and verification.
@.entire/graph-agent.md
<!-- entire-graph:end -->
```

After, when `CLAUDE.md` already imports `AGENTS.md`:

```md
<!-- entire-graph:begin -->
<!-- Entire Graph instructions are inherited through AGENTS.md. -->
<!-- entire-graph:end -->
```

The acceptance criterion stays unchanged; the product will satisfy it. Only the now-stale explanatory paragraph in the plan changes.

Before:

> Test the Claude Code layout where `CLAUDE.md` already imports `AGENTS.md`. `init-agents` writes the same pointer block to both files, so that layout can import the guide twice; document the supported resolution rather than hiding it.

After:

> Test the Claude Code layout where `CLAUDE.md` already imports `AGENTS.md`. `init-agents` must use the existing import as the single path to the Entire Graph guide, migrate legacy duplicate blocks, preserve unrelated content, and remain idempotent on reruns.
